summary: Tests-only run for issue #39 (red phase). Committed: (1) byte-identical parity corpus fixture from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) + corpus loader/bridge + SolverParityCorpusTests enforcing exact per-candidate scores, exclusions, earliest-wins selection, and tie evidence across all 12 scenarios; (2) GeneratedOpenAPIClientAdoptionTests — red milestone tests pinning the swift-openapi-generator/runtime Package.swift deps, the committed OpenAPI document at Sources/ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/openapi.yaml, and OpenAPIRuntime wiring into sources; (3) PaletteAPIClientContractTests pinning the /api/v1 behavior the migration must preserve; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md + docs/generated-openapi-client.md (includes /api/v1 shape-drift findings for the PR description). bin/lint passed (no Swift toolchain in container, script skips build by design). swift test could NOT be executed in this environment — no Swift toolchain is installed; parity semantics were instead verified by an exact IEEE-754 Python simulation of WeightedSquaredErrorScorer + earliest-wins selection against the committed fixture: 12/12 scenarios pass with exact float equality (tmp/parity-simulation.txt). Structural red tests are expected-red; implementation (deps, openapi.yaml, generated client, README links) is deferred to the post-paid-tests-approved implementation run per phase rules.
